name: Crumb
description: Pet recovery brand built around a stainless-steel QR-code pet tag linked to the pet's online profile, with an app and premium tracking tiers aimed at ending pet theft and loss. Its own partner program pays commission on every new user referred, with monthly payouts and a dedicated affiliate manager.

evidence.summary: Crumb's own Partners, Ambassadors & Affiliates page (fetched in full) states 'No cap on volumes - There's no limit to what you can earn as a Crumb affiliate' and repeats in its FAQ: 'There's no limit to what you can earn as a Crumb affiliate. We offer competitive commission rates' - an explicit no-earnings-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. No percentage rate is published on the page, so commission_rate is null.

Program mechanics from the same page: commission on every new user referred, paid monthly by wire transfer or PayPal every 30 days, 365-day attribution on affiliate links, dedicated affiliate manager, real-time dashboard, registration via affiliates.crumb.pet; the page also cites a 4.6/5 rating across 21,437 reviews and 'millions of pets already signed up'. No creator count is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: QR pet ID tags and pet recovery are a core pet-creator topic with strong lost-pet storytelling content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs an open affiliate/ambassador program and explicitly recruits Instagram influencers and creators on its own partner page.
reasons.compensation: Earnings cap is verified uncapped in the brand's own words, but no percentage rate is published, so the rate side stays mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Open partner registration portal plus a dedicated affiliate manager; no public program email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Registration is open now through affiliates.crumb.pet with monthly payouts.
reasons.credibility: Established pet-tech brand citing 4.6/5 across 21,437 reviews and millions of pets signed up on its own page.

name: Get Zippi
description: DTC home-cleaning gadget brand (GetZippi.com) selling cordless floor sweepers, a cordless portable pressure washer and a spin-and-steam mop that have gone viral on social video. Its affiliate program runs on Awin and states there are no earning limits.

evidence.summary: Get Zippi's Awin merchant profile (fetched in full) states 'You'll earn 20% on every sale, with no earning limits' - an explicit statement that total affiliate earnings are not capped, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

The same profile contradicts itself on rate: the headline and body say 20% on every sale (average commission $12-$30 per order), while the Program Highlights list '15% commission on every sale'. Because the program's own listing conflicts, commission_rate is recorded as null. The profile also lists a 30-day cookie and product-line AOVs of $80-$200. No creator count is published, so saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Viral cleaning gadgets are a proven home-content category, especially demo-driven floor-care products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile explicitly addresses TikTok, YouTube and blog audiences and the products built their name on social video.
reasons.compensation: Earnings are stated as having no limits (uncapped), but the profile's own 20% vs 15% rate conflict keeps the rate unrecorded and the score mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the Awin merchant profile; no public creator contact email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and joinable on Awin with a 30-day cookie and real-time dashboard.
reasons.credibility: Smaller DTC gadget brand; claims are from its own network listing without independent corroboration.
